searchText: when l2 transactions are compressed and batched then sent to L1 as CALLDATA, how can one (who?) run checks if a L2 state transition is valid? Note: it is all theoretical. At the moment, all used L2s have strictly worse security than L1. That is, they have all of the risk of the L1 plus L2 risks on top.
